blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Photographic composition aims to provide visual guidance for improving the framing, viewpoint, and spatial arrangement of an image. Early methods primarily rely on image cropping to enhance composition, which is restricted to the viewpoint and spatial arrangement of the input image. Recent methods have explored image understanding and editing to improve composition, but they mainly focus on instruction following and aesthetic quality, overlooking the importance of 3D scene geometry consistency for photographic composition. In this work, we propose GeoComposer, a novel geometry-grounded photographic composition framework that analyzes the composition of a given image to generate textual guidance and synthesizes a visual exemplar that enhances the composition of the given image. To promote geometry-grounded composition, we propose a geometry-aware representation learning mechanism that leverages geometric priors from a visual geometry foundation model to shape the intermediate representations of the composition editing model. This mechanism preserves both global structural relationships and local fine-grained correspondences for geometry-grounded composition. Furthermore, we propose a reinforcement learning strategy guided by a hybrid reward that jointly optimizes instruction following, aesthetic quality, and geometric consistency. This enables the model to generate visual exemplars that faithfully follow the composition instructions while remaining visually appealing and geometrically consistent. Extensive experiments show the superiority of our approach over state-of-the-art methods, highlighting its effectiveness in generating visually appealing and geometrically consistent composition.
Project page: https://geocomposer.github.io/ .

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Photographic composition plays a fundamental role in visual storytelling.
It involves the careful arrangement of framing, viewpoint, and spatial relationships to enhance the aesthetic quality and narrative impact of an image.
This has motivated the development of intelligent composition assistance methods [ 38 , 7 , 12 , 41 ] that provide visual guidance, optionally accompanied by textual instructions, to improve photographic composition more intuitively and effectively.
Such guidance is particularly valuable for casual photographers, who may lack expertise in framing and composition.
blocks.zh:
相片组成在视觉故事讲述中起根本作用.
它涉及精心安排框架、观点和空间关系,以提高图像的美学质量和叙述影响。
这推动了智能成像辅助方法[38,7,12,41]的发展,提供了可选的视觉指导,并附有文字指示,以更直观地,更有效地改进相片组成.
这种指导对临时摄影师特别有价值,他们可能缺乏设定和组成方面的专业知识。

blocks.en:
Early approaches to photographic composition primarily focus on image cropping [ 24 , 6 , 10 ] , which select aesthetically pleasing regions from an input image to refine framing and subject placement.
However, these methods are inherently restricted to the viewpoint and spatial arrangement of the input image, allowing only limited post-processing of its framing and spatial layout.
Recent advances in image generation and editing [ 30 , 11 , 33 , 3 ] have enabled more flexible instruction-following image manipulation.
However, most of these methods primarily focus on semantic consistency and instruction fidelity, but remain less effective at following composition-specific instructions and often produce suboptimal compositional results.
In addition, there have been some efforts to develop photographic composition guidance methods that analyze compositional deficiencies of input images and generate aesthetically-enhanced visual exemplars for better composition [ 38 , 12 , 5 ] .
Although these methods have shown promising performance in generating visually appealing composition, they mostly overlook 3D scene geometry consistency in photographic composition, which is crucial for generating viewpoint variations and ensuring spatial coherence.

blocks.en:
In this work, we propose GeoComposer, a novel geometry-grounded photographic composition framework that provides both textual guidance and visual exemplars to enhance the composition of input images.
Specifically, GeoComposer employs a composition understanding model to analyze the compositional deficiencies of an input image and generate textual guidance that describes how to improve its composition.
This textual guidance provides users with an interpretable explanation, while also serving as a prompt for a composition editing model to generate a visual exemplar of the suggested adjustment.
However, guided solely by textual instructions, the composition editing model struggles to generate visually appealing and geometrically consistent compositions, as the instructions may not fully capture the underlying 3D scene geometry.
To address this challenge, we propose a geometry-aware representation learning mechanism that shapes the intermediate representation of the composition editing model with geometry-aware tokens from a visual geometry foundation model [ 26 , 28 ] via a global structural supervision and a local correspondence supervision.
This incorporates 3D geometric priors from a visual geometry foundation model into the composition editing model, enhancing its understanding of spatial relationships and viewpoint variations.
Moreover, we introduce a reinforcement learning (RL) strategy that optimizes the composition editing model with a hybrid reward.
In contrast to existing reward formulations that focus primarily on instruction-following and perceptual quality, our hybrid reward explicitly enforces geometric consistency during optimization while also considering instruction fidelity and aesthetic quality.
As a result, our approach generates visual exemplars that are not only faithfully following the composition instructions but also visually appealing and geometrically consistent.
We conduct extensive experiments to evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed GeoComposer framework, demonstrating its superiority over state-of-the-art methods in generating visually appealing and geometrically consistent composition.
Our main contributions are: • We propose a geometry-grounded photographic composition framework that comprehensively resolves the challenges of instruction-following, compositional quality, and geometric consistency in photographic composition. • We introduce a geometry-aware representation learning mechanism that incorporates 3D geometric priors from a visual geometry foundation model into the composition editing model, enhancing its understanding of spatial relationships and viewpoint variations. • We design a reinforcement learning strategy guided by a hybrid reward for optimizing the composition editing model, explicitly enforcing geometric consistency while also considering instruction fidelity and aesthetic quality.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Photographic Composition. Photographic composition has progressed substantially over the years, evolving from conventional cropping-based methods to generative editing and multimodal composition methods.
Specifically, conventional methods, such as [ 24 , 6 , 40 , 10 ] , approach photographic composition as an image cropping problem.
This paradigm primarily improves composition by selecting aesthetically favorable subregions of the input image through content-aware, subject-aware, or aspect-ratio-aware cropping.
Since these methods do not alter the underlying scene content or viewpoint, they are inherently restricted to the viewpoint and spatial arrangement of the input image, allowing only limited post-processing of its framing and spatial layout.
With rapid advances in generative models, recent methods have moved beyond conventional cropping toward generative image editing and unified multimodal frameworks that jointly support composition understanding and generation [ 38 , 5 , 36 ] .
Despite these advances, existing methods primarily focus on instruction following and aesthetic quality, while paying limited attention to the geometric consistency of the edited scene.
Consequently, they often struggle to preserve spatial consistency under substantial viewpoint or layout modifications.
Our work addresses the limitations of existing methods by introducing a novel multimodal geometry-grounded photographic composition framework with comprehensive compositional understanding and generation capabilities.
Our framework incorporates geometry-aware representation learning and reinforcement learning guided by a hybrid reward to ensure that the generated visual exemplars are not only aesthetically pleasing and instruction-following but also geometrically consistent with the underlying 3D scene structure.
blocks.zh:
摄影组成. 多年来,摄影成份有了很大进展,从传统的以收割为基础的方法发展到基因编辑和多模式成份方法。
具体地说,传统方法,如[24,6,40,10],将相片组成视为图像收割问题.
这一范式主要通过对内容的认知、对主题的认知或对面的认知来选择对输入图像具有审美偏好的分区来改善组成。
由于这些方法不会改变基本的场景内容或观点,它们本身就局限于输入图像的视角和空间安排,只能对其框架和空间布局进行有限的后处理.
随着基因模型的迅速进步,最近的方法已经超越了传统的收成方式,转向基因图像编辑和统一的多式联运框架,这些框架共同支持对组成的理解和生成[38、5、36]。
尽管取得了这些进步,但现有方法主要侧重于后续教学和美学质量,同时对被编辑的场景的几何一致性给予了有限的关注.
因此,它们往往难以在重大观点或布局变化下保持空间一致性。
我们的工作涉及现有方法的局限性,采用了新的多模式几何基础摄影组成框架,具有全面的组成理解和生成能力。
我们的框架在混合奖励的指导下,包括了几何-感知表现学习和强化学习,以确保所产生的视觉实例不仅在美学上令人愉快并遵循教学,而且与基本的三维场景结构相一致。

blocks.en:
Image Editing. The rapid development of diffusion models has significantly advanced image editing, enabling flexible and high-quality image manipulation.
A typical image-editing paradigm employs a generative model, such as a diffusion model, to transform an input image into a desired output image conditioned on textual prompts or other control conditions [ 3 , 11 , 22 , 30 ] .
Existing methods have demonstrated strong instruction-following capabilities while maintaining semantic consistency with the input image.
However, these methods are designed for general-purpose image editing and less effective for photographic composition, as they mainly optimize instruction-following and visual quality rather than compositional quality and geometric consistency.
In contrast, our framework is specifically designed for photographic composition, integrating a composition understanding model to analyze compositional deficiencies and generate composition-aware guidance and a composition editing model to generate visual exemplars that are aesthetically pleasing, instruction-following, and geometrically consistent with the underlying 3D scene structure.
blocks.zh:
图像编辑. 传播模型的迅速发展使图像编辑工作有了显著的进步,能够灵活而高质量的图像操纵.
一个典型的图像编辑范式采用了一种基因模型,如扩散模型,将输入图像转换成以文字提示或其他控制条件为条件的所期望的输出图像[3,11,22,30].
现有方法在保持与输入图像的语义一致性的同时,表现出了强大的遵循指令的能力.
然而,这些方法是为通用图像编辑而设计的,对相片组成效果较低,因为它们主要优化了指令跟随和视觉质量,而不是组成质量和几何一致性.
对比之下,我们的框架专门设计为相片组成,整合一个构象理解模型来分析构象缺陷,生成构象意识引导和构象编辑模型来生成视觉实例,这些实例在美学上是取悦的,遵循指令的,在几何上与基本的3D场景结构一致.

Composition Understanding. Given a poorly-composed image I p I^{p} , we employ a composition understanding model to analyze its compositional deficiencies and generate textual guidance T T that describes how the composition can be improved. Rather than producing a vague verdict of image quality, T T is required to be actionable : it specifies concrete framing adjustments together with brief justifications, so that T T can directly condition the downstream editing model.
Since generic Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are not tailored to photographic composition and tend to yield generic or non-executable descriptions, we fine-tune a VLM (e.g., Qwen3-VL [ 19 ] ) on paired data of poorly-composed images and their corresponding improvement instructions.
To make the guidance operation-aware, the model is conditioned on a task prompt T t ​ a ​ s ​ k T_{task} that indicates the intended type of adjustment (e.g., shifting, zooming, or viewpoint change), and is trained under a mixture of general task prompts so that it can handle both operator-specified intent and fully automatic composition improvement.

The ground-truth guidance in our training data (please refer to the supplementary material for details) is grounded in real well- and poorly-composed image pairs, and describes the framing transformation that turns the poor composition I p I^{p} into its well-composed counterpart. Training on such grounded supervision drives the model to produce concrete, geometry-aware framing-operation guidance that corresponds to a realizable recomposition.
The generated textual guidance serves a dual purpose: providing users with interpretable composition suggestions and prompting the composition editing model to generate a visual exemplar.

Visual Exemplar Generation. Next, we employ a diffusion-based composition editing model to generate a visual exemplar I g I^{g} that is compositionally improved according to the textual guidance. During training , the composition editing model takes T T , I p I^{p} , and I t I^{t} as input to learn the compositional transformation from I p I^{p} to its corresponding well-composed I t I^{t} .
Specifically, we first generate multimodal conditions by encoding T T and I p I^{p} into semantic embeddings using a vision-language encoder [ 30 ] and also encoding I p I^{p} into a latent condition using a variational autoencoder (VAE).
In addition, we encode I t I^{t} into a latent representation z 0 z_{0} using the same VAE and add Gaussian noise ϵ ∼ 𝒩 ⁡ ( 0 , I ) \epsilon\sim\mathcal{N}(0,I) to z 0 z_{0} to obtain the noisy latent z t z_{t} at timestep t t .
Then, we train a Diffusion Transformer (DiT) to denoise z t z_{t} under the multimodal conditions, thereby learning the target compositional transformation.
To capture the underlying 3D scene structure, we introduce Geometry-Aware Representation Learning to distill geometry-aware knowledge from a pretrained visual geometry foundation model [ 26 ] into the intermediate representations of the DiT through global structural supervision and local correspondence supervision.
Moreover, we introduce Hybrid Reward-Guided Reinforcement Learning (RL) to further optimize the DiT with a hybrid reward that jointly evaluates instruction following, visual quality, and geometric consistency. During inference , the model only takes T T and I p I^{p} as input to generate the composition-enhanced exemplar I g I^{g} . The additional geometry foundation model, reinforcement learning, and the associated computational overhead are only required during training , while the inference process follows the original diffusion pipeline.

blocks.en: 3.2 Geometry-Aware Representation Learning
blocks.zh: 3.2 几何-了解表现学习

blocks.en:
Motivation. Since the textual guidance generated by the composition understanding model may not fully capture the underlying 3D scene geometry, the composition editing model struggles to generate geometrically consistent compositions when guided solely by textual instructions.
We therefore propose to distill geometry-aware knowledge from a visual geometry foundation model [ 26 , 28 ] into the intermediate representations of the DiT.
Unlike existing representation alignment methods [ 39 , 23 , 34 ] that primarily focus on transferring semantic knowledge from vision foundation models, our approach aims to distill geometric knowledge from geometry foundation models to enhance geometry awareness for photographic composition through two complementary supervisions:
1) a global structural supervision that enforces the DiT to maintain the same global structural information as the geometry-aware representations;
2) a local correspondence supervision that encourages the DiT features to align with the geometry-aware representations at a local level.

因此,我们提议从可视几何基础模型[26,28]中将几何知识分馏入DiT的中间代表.

blocks.en: 3.3 Hybrid Reward-Guided Reinforcement Learning
blocks.zh: 3.3 混合奖励指导强化学习

blocks.en:
Motivation. Although Geometry-Aware Representation Learning distills 3D geometric priors into the DiT, its diffusion objective remains a denoising trajectory that regresses toward the ground-truth reference.
However, photographic composition is inherently multi-solution. That is, for a poorly-composed image, there may exist many potential reframings.
Thus, supervising the model to reproduce one particular target both suppresses this diversity and caps the attainable quality at that of the reference.
Moreover, the training objective ℒ geo \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{geo}} cannot jointly enforce instruction-following, aesthetic quality, and geometric consistency, as it only provides a reconstruction-based supervision that encourages the model to reproduce the reference image.
We therefore further optimize the composition editing model through Hybrid Reward-Guided Reinforcement Learning , which replaces single-target regression with reward objectives evaluated directly on generated images.
This lets the RL policy explore the space of valid compositions beyond ground truth , producing edits that are simultaneously instruction-aligned, visually realistic, and geometrically coherent.

然而,相片构成本质上是多解决方案的. 也就是说,对于结构差的图像来说,可能存在许多潜在的再现。
因此,监督复制某一具体目标的模式既抑制了这种多样性,又将可达到的质量限制在参考水平上。

Hybrid Reward. Existing RL approaches for image editing typically rely on an editing reward that evaluates instruction following and semantic quality.
However, for photographic composition, a comprehensive evaluation should consider not only instruction fidelity, but also aesthetic quality and geometric consistency.
In light of this, we introduce a hybrid reward R hyb R_{\mathrm{hyb}} that encourages the diffusion policy to generate edits that are instruction-following, visually appealing, and geometrically consistent: R hyb = λ ins ​ R ins + λ qua ​ R qua + λ geo ​ R geo , R_{\mathrm{hyb}}=\lambda_{\mathrm{ins}}R_{\mathrm{ins}}+\lambda_{\mathrm{qua}}R_{\mathrm{qua}}+\lambda_{\mathrm{geo}}R_{\mathrm{geo}}, (6) where R ins R_{\mathrm{ins}} , R qua R_{\mathrm{qua}} , and R geo R_{\mathrm{geo}} denote the instruction-following, aesthetic-quality, and geometry-consistency rewards, respectively, while λ ins \lambda_{\mathrm{ins}} , λ qua \lambda_{\mathrm{qua}} , and λ geo \lambda_{\mathrm{geo}} are weighting coefficients that balance their respective contributions.

Specifically, for R ins R_{\mathrm{ins}} , we use a VLM to jointly process the input image, the generated image, and the textual instruction to estimate the degree of editing success while penalizing unnecessary modifications to the original content: R ins = f vlm ​ ( I p , I c , T ) , R_{\mathrm{ins}}=f_{\mathrm{vlm}}(I^{p},I^{c},T), (7) where f vlm f_{\mathrm{vlm}} is a VLM that outputs an instruction-following score.
For R qua R_{\mathrm{qua}} , we employ a VLM to evaluate the generated image in terms of naturalness and aesthetic quality as: R qua = f vlm ​ ( I c , T p ) , R_{\mathrm{qua}}=f_{\mathrm{vlm}}(I^{c},T^{p}), (8) where f vlm f_{\mathrm{vlm}} is a VLM that outputs a quality score, and T p T^{p} is a prompt that instructs the VLM to assess the quality of the generated image.
Although these two rewards encourage semantically correct and visually appealing outputs, they do not enforce geometric plausibility.
Consequently, the results may favor improvements that increase the editing score at the expense of 3D scene consistency.
To resolve this problem, we introduce a geometry-aware scene-consistency reward R geo R_{\mathrm{geo}} derived from a visual geometry foundation model.
We use a geometry foundation model to extract patch representations together with intermediate attention features.
Then, we compute patch-level geometric relevance using two complementary cues [ 9 ] , including (1) attention relevance derived from global attention patterns of the model and (2) geometry-aware feature similarity between patch representations.
The resulting patch-level relevance values are aggregated using generalized mean (GeM) pooling [ 20 ] to obtain image-level attention and feature relevance scores.
Specifically, let S x → y S^{x{\rightarrow}y} denote the directed geometry relevance score from image I x I^{x} to image I y I^{y} .
Each image I x I^{x} has its patch tokens F x F_{x} along with query features Q x Q_{x} and key features K x K_{x} probed from the attention layer.
The attention relevance sums, for each source patch, the softmax attention mass it assigns to patches F y F_{y} : S attn x → y = GeM p ​ ( ∑ i ∈ F y softmax ⁡ ( Q x ⊤ ​ K y d ) ) , S_{\mathrm{attn}}^{x\rightarrow y}=\mathrm{GeM}_{p}\left(\sum_{i\in{F}_{y}}\mathrm{softmax}\left(\frac{Q_{x}^{\top}K_{y}}{\sqrt{d}}\right)\right), (9) where d d is the head dimension and the softmax is normalized over all tokens.
The feature similarity takes, for each source patch, its maximum cosine match in F y F_{y} : S feat x → y = GeM p ​ ( ϕ ⁡ ( F x ⊤ ​ F y ‖ F x ‖ ​ ‖ F y ‖ ) ) , S_{\mathrm{feat}}^{x\rightarrow y}=\mathrm{GeM}_{p}\left(\phi\left(\frac{F_{x}^{\top}F_{y}}{\|F_{x}\|\|F_{y}\|}\right)\right), (10) where ϕ ⁡ ( ⋅ ) \phi(\cdot) denotes the log-sum-exp for obtaining a soft maximum. The two complementary measures are combined as: S x → y = λ attn ​ S attn x → y + λ feat ​ S feat x → y , S^{x\rightarrow y}=\lambda_{\mathrm{attn}}S_{\mathrm{attn}}^{x\rightarrow y}+\lambda_{\mathrm{feat}}S_{\mathrm{feat}}^{x\rightarrow y}, (11) where λ attn \lambda_{\mathrm{attn}} and λ feat \lambda_{\mathrm{feat}} control relative contributions of two measures.
To obtain a symmetric geometry consistency measure, we average the bidirectional relevance scores between the generated image and both the source and target images, R src = S p → c + S c → p 2 , R tgt = S t → c + S c → t 2 , R_{\mathrm{src}}=\frac{S^{p\rightarrow c}+S^{c\rightarrow p}}{2},\qquad R_{\mathrm{tgt}}=\frac{S^{t\rightarrow c}+S^{c\rightarrow t}}{2}, (12) where S p → c S^{p\rightarrow c} and S c → p S^{c\rightarrow p} denote the directed relevance scores between the source and generated images, while S t → c S^{t\rightarrow c} and S c → t S^{c\rightarrow t} denote the directed relevance scores between the target and generated images. R src R_{\mathrm{src}} encourages the generated image to preserve the geometric structure of the source image, whereas R tgt R_{\mathrm{tgt}} encourages geometric alignment with the desired composition represented by the target image.
Finally, the geometry-aware reward is computed as: R geo = w s ​ R src + w t ​ R tgt , R_{\mathrm{geo}}=w_{s}R_{\mathrm{src}}+w_{t}R_{\mathrm{tgt}}, (13) where w s w_{s} and w t w_{t} control the relative importance of source preservation and target alignment, respectively.
The geometry reward penalizes outputs that achieve high editing scores through spatially inconsistent changes, solving reward hacking and encouraging generated images that are instruction-aligned, visually realistic, and geometrically coherent.

Negative-Aware Optimization. Following DiffusionNFT [ 42 ] , we compute a group-relative advantage for each candidate by normalizing its hybrid reward against the statistics of the K K rollouts generated for the same input.
The normalized advantage weights a continuous interpolation between a positive and a negative velocity target for each candidate: candidates scoring above the group average are drawn toward the positive target, while those scoring below it are pushed toward a negative target constructed by mirroring the current velocity prediction about that of the reference policy.
Within the flow matching framework, these mirrored targets provide counterfactual supervision that penalizes low-reward candidates, whether geometrically inconsistent or otherwise inferior, guiding the diffusion policy toward instruction-aligned, visually realistic, and geometrically consistent image generation.

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
Datasets. Following the data construction in PhotoFramer [ 38 ] , we build the dataset on top of public datasets, i.e., CPC [ 29 ] , GAIC [ 40 ] , FLMS [ 6 ] , CUHK-ICD [ 35 ] , and Unsplash [ 25 ] , from which composition pairs and their text guidance are derived.
We train and validate GeoComposer on the constructed dataset of 34,129 ⟨ \langle poor, good, text-guidance ⟩ \rangle triplets, with the full construction pipeline detailed in the supplementary material.
The dataset is split at the source-image level into 33,229 training and 900 validation triplets.
To further assess generalization beyond the constructed dataset, we additionally evaluate on a held-out benchmark, DL3DV [ 13 ] , which is disjoint from the training data.
blocks.zh:
数据集. 在PhotoFramer [38]中数据构建后,我们将在公共数据集上方构建数据集,即CPC [29],GAIC [40],FLMS [6],CUHK-ICD [35],和Unsplash [25],从中推导出成分对及其文本指导.

数据集在源图像层面分为33,229个培训和900个验证三进制.
为了进一步评估超出已建数据集的通用性,我们还对DL3DV[13]这一与培训数据脱节的搁置基准进行了额外评估。

Evaluation Metrics. We evaluate along four automatic axes together with a human study. 1 1 1 Detailed metric protocols, per-baseline descriptions, and full implementation details are provided in the supplementary material. For composition , Comp. WinRate is the pairwise win rate of the edited image against the source, and PF-ass is the single-image PhotoFramer composition score [ 38 ] .
For image quality , QAlign [ 31 ] and DeQA [ 37 ] measure no-reference aesthetic and general image quality.
For geometric consistency , MET3R [ 1 ] measures multi-view 3D consistency (lower is better), and Geo-Suc, an LLM-judge metric, measures whether the edit realizes the correct viewpoint change rather than merely altering the image.
For text-guidance accuracy , Text Cons. (src → \rightarrow gen) and (src → \rightarrow GT) score how faithfully the reasoning text describes the method’s own edit and the human reframing [ 38 ] .
The human study reports the fraction of edits judged both geometrically valid and better composed than the source.
Unless noted, all LLM-judge metrics use GPT-5.4 as the judge.

blocks.en: 4.2 Comparison with State-of-the-Art Methods
blocks.zh: 4.2 与最新方法的比较

blocks.en:
Table 1 reports the quantitative comparison on the constructed validation set.
GeoComposer achieves the best performance on seven of the eight metrics and remains highly competitive on the remaining one.
For composition, our method attains a win rate of 78.1%, together with the best PF-ass score.
For image quality, our method achieves the best QAlign score and a DeQA score on par with the best Nano Banana Pro.
For geometric consistency, our method achieves the best MET3R and the best Geo-Suc, indicating that GeoComposer performs the intended photographic changes while preserving the underlying 3D scene structure.
Notably, competitive baselines exhibit a clear trade-off between the two geometry metrics: BAGEL attains a relatively high Geo-Suc but a near-50% win rate, suggesting conservative edits, whereas Nano Banana Pro edits more aggressively at the cost of geometric correctness.
In contrast, GeoComposer is the only method that ranks first on both composition and geometric consistency, demonstrating that our geometry-grounded design improves composition without sacrificing spatial coherence.
For text-guidance accuracy, our method produces the most faithful and correct textual guidance, outperforming PhotoFramer on both Text Cons. (src → \rightarrow gen) and Text Cons. (src → \rightarrow GT).
The human study further corroborates these results, where GeoComposer is judged an overall improvement over the source in 85.6% of cases, far exceeding the strongest baseline at 63.9%.
As shown in Fig. 3 , GeoComposer also produces the most visually appealing and geometrically consistent composition among all methods.
GeoComposer further generalizes to the held-out DL3DV benchmark, achieving the best geometric consistency, as detailed in the supplementary material.

blocks.en: 4.3 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 4.3 阅读研究

blocks.en:
Effectiveness of Each Component. Table 2 presents the ablation of the three key components of GeoComposer, i.e., the composition understanding model, geometry-aware representation learning (Stage I), and hybrid reward-guided reinforcement learning (Stage II), on top of the Qwen-Image-Edit backbone.
Introducing the composition understanding model improves composition and image quality, as the generated guidance drives more substantial compositional edits, but this comes at the cost of degraded geometric consistency.
Adding geometry-aware representation learning substantially restores geometric consistency while maintaining comparable quality, validating the effectiveness of distilling 3D geometric priors into the DiT.
Hybrid reward-guided reinforcement learning further improves all four metrics simultaneously, confirming that image-level reward optimization complements representation-level geometry distillation.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
In this work, we present a geometry-grounded framework named GeoComposer for multimodal photographic composition.
GeoComposer produces textual guidance from a composition understanding model and generates visual exemplars from a composition editing model with geometry-aware representation learning and hybrid reward-guided reinforcement learning.
Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach outperforms state-of-the-art methods in generating visually appealing and geometrically consistent compositions.
blocks.zh:
在这项工作中,我们提出一个几何定位框架,取名为多式相片构成的地相计算器。
GeoComposer从一个构象理解模型产生文字指导,并生成一个构象编辑模型的视觉实例,其中包含有几何-知觉表现学习和混合奖励-导增强学习.
广泛的实验表明,我们的方法在产生视觉吸引力和几何一致性的构成方面,比最先进的方法要好。

blocks.en: 6 Limitation and Future Work
blocks.zh: 6 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en:
Despite achieving compelling performance, our method still has some limitations.
First, our approach operates on a single input image to generate textual guidance and a visual exemplar.
However, a single view may provide incomplete scene context and fail to capture the full spatial structure of the environment.
Extending the framework to support multiple input views is a promising direction for future work.
In addition, photographic composition is a relatively subjective process, and multiple aesthetically pleasing compositions may exist for the same scene.
By generating only a single visual exemplar, our framework may not fully capture the diversity of individual preferences.
Future work could explore incorporating user-specific preferences to provide more diverse and personalized composition guidance.
blocks.zh:
尽管取得了令人信服的业绩,但我们的方法仍然有一些局限性。
首先,我们的方法在单一输入图像上运作,生成文字指导和视觉实例。
然而,单景可能提供不完全的场景上下文,并未能捕捉环境的全部空间结构.
扩大框架以支持多种投入观点是未来工作的一个有希望的方向。
此外,相片组成是一个相对主观的过程,对于同场景来说可能存在多种审美取悦的构成.
我们的框架仅仅产生一个单一的视觉实例,可能无法充分抓住个人偏好的多样性。
今后的工作可以探讨纳入用户特有的偏好,提供更加多样化和个性化的构成指导。

blocks.en: Appendix A Dataset Construction
blocks.zh: 附录A 数据集构建

blocks.en:
We follow the data construction protocol of PhotoFramer [ 38 ] and build the dataset on top of existing public datasets, i.e., the human-annotated crop-scoring datasets and expert photographs listed below, from which the composition pairs and their text guidance are derived.
The constructed dataset consists of 34,129 ⟨ \langle poor , good , text-guidance ⟩ \rangle triplets organized into three composition operations that mirror how casual photographs are re-composed, namely shift (in-plane re-framing), zoom-in (tightening the framing toward the subject), and view change (camera viewpoint variation).
Each triplet pairs a poorly-composed image with a well-composed counterpart of the same scene, together with a natural-language guidance describing the poor → \rightarrow good compositional adjustment.
Table 6 summarizes the per-task statistics.
The shift and zoom-in pairs are obtained by re-cropping real photographs, whereas the view change pairs are synthesized from expert photographs; all accepted pairs are finally annotated with text guidance.

我们遵循PhotoFramer的数据构建协议[38],将数据集建在现有公共数据集上方,即以下列出的人为注释作物评分数据集和专家相片,从中推导出成对成分及其文字指导.
构建的数据集由34,129个\langle poor, good, text-guide \\rangle 三重相机组成,组成三个组成操作,反映了临时相机是如何重新组合的,即转变(在飞机中重新显示)、放大(对主题的框框进行收缩)和视图变化(相机视角变化)。
每对三胞胎配对一个结构差的相像,并配有同一场景的相对相像,并配有自然语言的指向来描述贫穷者 ~\直率的好组成调整.
表6汇总了每项任务的统计数据。
换相和缩放成对是通过重新剪接真实相片得到的,而取景变化相片则由专家相片合成;所有被接受相片最终被附加了文字指导.

blocks.en:
Shift and Zoom-in Pairs. The two subsets are built from crop-scoring datasets, i.e., CPC [ 29 ] , GAIC [ 40 ] , FLMS [ 6 ] , and CUHK-ICD [ 35 ] , whose expert crops serve as well-composed references, with the per-subset sources listed in Table 6 .
For shift , we sample two crops of the same aspect ratio from a source image, where the good crop is a high-scoring expert crop and the poor crop is a positionally offset crop, to which we further apply a small random rotation to emulate the tilted horizon typical of amateur framing.
For zoom-in , the good image is a tightly composed high-scoring crop and the poor image is a larger crop that contains it, emulating a wider or more distant framing; we enforce that the good crop covers at most 60% of the poor crop in area to ensure a genuine change of framing rather than a near-identical re-crop.
A candidate pair passes a cascade of filters that jointly enforce three properties, and is accepted only if all of them are satisfied.
(i) Same scene : the poor and good crops must depict the same content, verified by a CLIP [ 21 ] similarity ≥ 0.8 \geq 0.8 and a subject-consistency check that matches U 2 -Net [ 18 ] salient regions via DINOv2 [ 17 ] cosine similarity ≥ 0.6 \geq 0.6 .
(ii) Composition gap : the good crop must be genuinely better composed, enforced by an aesthetic gate on the good crop (Q-Align [ 31 ] ≥ 2.5 \geq 2.5 ) and a positive composition-score margin between the good and poor crops given by the source annotations.
(iii) Valid operation : we pair only crops of the same aspect ratio within [ 0.45 , 2.2 ] [0.45,2.2] , and for shift we additionally reject pairs in which one crop nearly contains the other, as such a containment relation corresponds to a zoom rather than an in-plane shift.
blocks.zh:
移动和放大对等。 这两个子集来自作物评分数据集,即CPC [29],GAIC [40],FLMS [6],和CUHK-ICD [35],其专家作物作为很好的参考,每个子集的来源列于表6.
对于转变,我们从一个源头图像中抽取了两个相同侧面比的作物,其中好作物是高分的专家作物,而劣作物是位置相抵消的作物,我们对此进一步运用了小的随机旋转来模仿业余栽培的典型的倾斜地平线.
对缩放来说,好的形象是紧密搭配的高分作物,而差的形象是更大的作物,包含它,模仿范围更广或更远的布局;我们强制要求,好作物最多覆盖该地区60%的劣作物,以确保真正改变布局,而不是接近相同的再作物。
候选配对通过一连串的滤波器,共同执行三个属性,只有在它们都满意的情况下才能被接受.
(一)同一场景:劣质和好收成必须描绘出相同内容,经CLIP[21]相似度 0.8\geq 0.8和通过DINOv2[17]余弦相似度 0.6\geq 0.6进行与U2-Net相匹配的主题一致性检查.
(二) 组成差距:良好作物必须真正更好地组成,由良好作物上的美学门(Q-Align [31] 2.5\geq 2.5)和来源说明给出的好作物和劣作物之间的正组成-分数差。
(三) 有效操作:在[0.45, 2.2] [0.45,2.2] 范围内,我们只将相同方相比的作物对成一对,为了转移,我们还拒绝一种作物几乎含有另一种作物的对成一对,因为这种封存关系相当于放大,而不是飞机中的变化。

blocks.en: Table 6: Per-task statistics of the constructed dataset. The view-change poor images are synthesized from Unsplash expert photographs.
blocks.zh: 表6:已建数据集的每个任务统计。 取景变差的图像由Unsplash专家相片合成.

blocks.en:
View-Change Pairs. Paired real viewpoint-change data are scarce, and their aesthetic and compositional quality is inherently limited, e.g., multi-view frames captured for 3D reconstruction, which caps the quality of the frames that can serve as well-composed good references.
Since the good image defines the compositional quality the model is trained to reproduce, it must itself satisfy a high aesthetic and compositional standard.
We therefore synthesize this subset from a curated dataset of real high-quality photographs, Unsplash [ 25 ] .
Starting from an expert photograph as the good image, we apply camera-motion editing instructions (e.g., turn, move, rotate) to different directions with discrete magnitudes (slightly, moderately, and strongly) with Qwen-Image-Edit [ 30 ] to generate a viewpoint-shifted poor image with explicit prompts of worsening composition.
We then retain only genuine and correctly degraded pairs through a three-axis filter:
(1) Same Scene : besides a CLIP similarity ≥ 0.8 \geq 0.8 and a DINOv2 cosine similarity ≥ 0.6 \geq 0.6 between the salient regions of the poor and good images, we also leverage Qwen3.5-397B-A17B and human annotators to verify that the poor image is indeed a viewpoint-changed version of the good one;
(2) Valid Discrimination : a viewpoint-shift test based on mutual nearest-neighbor matching of DINOv2 patch tokens, keeping only pairs whose spatial displacement exceeds 5%, and a non-mirror test that removes pairs where the poor image is a left-right flip of the good one;
and (3) Composition gap : a non-inversion test that removes pairs whose synthesized “poor” image is in fact better composed than the good one, according to the Q-Align and PhotoFramer composition scorers [ 38 ] .
blocks.zh:
景-相变平. Paired real Field-change的数据很少,他们的审美和组成质量本质上是有限的,例如为3D重建所捕获的多视图帧,它封顶了能够作为良好参考的帧的质量.
由于好的形象定义了该模型训练来再生的成分质量,它本身必须满足高美学和成分标准.
因此,我们从一个真实的高质量照片的整理数据集Unsplash[25]综合了这个子集.
从专家相片作为好图像开始,我们将相机-动量编辑指示(如转动,移动,旋转)应用到不同方向,并有离散的分量(略微地,中度地,并强烈地)使用Quen-Image-Edit [30] 来生成一个透视转换的劣质图像,并明确提示成分恶化.
然后我们通过三轴滤波器只保留真实和正确的降解对:
(1) 同一场景:除了CLIP相似性 0.8\geq 0.8 和 DINOv2相相近性 0.6\geq 0.6 在贫穷的突出区域与良好图像之间,我们还利用Quen3.5-397B-A17B 和人文注释员来核实不良图像确实是一个观点变化的好图像版本;
(2) 有效歧视:基于相距相近的DINOv2补丁符号相匹配的视角-转变测试,只保留空间相位超过5%的对子,以及在不良图像是好图像的左向倒转的情况下去除对子的非模拟测试;
和(3)组成差距:一种非倒置测试,根据Q-Align和PhotoFramer组成分数计分器,去除其合成的"劣"相像实际上比好相像构成更好的对子 [38].

blocks.en:
Text-Guidance Annotation. For every ⟨ \langle poor, good ⟩ \rangle pair, we generate a natural-language editing instruction with a vision-language model (Qwen3.5-397B-A17B), which is shown the poor image as “Input photo” and the good image as “Desired result” and, cast as an expert composition editor, returns a self-contained instruction describing how to reframe the former into the latter.
The prompt constrains the model to composition-only edits (subject placement, balance, horizon, viewpoint) and forbids introducing new content or numeric coordinates, keeping each instruction grounded in the pair and free of hallucination.
blocks.zh:
文本指导注释. 对于每一个\\langle贫穷,好\\rangle配对,我们生成一个自然语言编辑指令,其中包含一个视觉语言模型(Quen3.5-397B-A17B),它显示的糟糕图像为"输入相片",而好图像为"死亡结果",并且作为专家组成编辑被放出,返回一个自成一体的指令,描述如何将前者重塑为后者.
即时将模型限制在只进行成分编辑(主体放置,平衡,地平线,视角),并禁止引入新的内容或数字坐标,使每个指令都建立在对上并不存在幻觉.

blocks.en:
Training and Validation Split. We split the dataset into 33,229 training and 900 validation triplets (300 per task).
The split is strictly disjoint at the source-image level so that no source image appears in both splits, preventing information leakage between training and evaluation.
blocks.zh:
培训与鉴定 我们把数据集分为33 229个培训和900个验证三重机(每任务300个)。
拆分在源图像层次上是严格脱节的,这样两个拆分中就不会出现源图像,防止了培训与评价之间的信息泄漏.

blocks.en:
Held-out Benchmark. To assess generalization beyond the constructed dataset, we additionally evaluate on a held-out benchmark that is disjoint from our training data and carries no text guidance, i.e., pure image-conditioned re-composition.
For view change , we sample 300 real multi-view pairs from DL3DV [ 13 ] , where the poor image is a scene’s native first frame and the good image is a better-composed frame (scored by the PhotoFramer composition scorer) within co-visibility [ 0.1 , 0.3 ] [0.1,0.3] with the poor image, providing a fully real out-of-distribution test of viewpoint change.
blocks.zh:
搁置基准。 为了评估超出已建数据集的通用性,我们额外评价了与我们的培训数据脱节、没有文字指导的搁置基准,即纯图像条件的再组合。
为了改变视野,我们从DL3DV[13]中抽取了300个真实的多视图对子,其中糟糕的图像是场景的原生第一帧,而好的形象则是在共同可见的[0.1,0.3][0.1.0.3]中,一个更好的组合的帧(由PhotoFramer成分分数器分数),与糟糕的图像进行完全真实的分布式的视角变化测试.

blocks.en: Appendix B Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: 附录B 评价计量

blocks.en:
We evaluate composition editing along four orthogonal axes, i.e., composition, image quality, geometric consistency, and text-guidance accuracy, together with a human study.
Unless otherwise noted, all LLM-judge metrics use the same frontier vision-language model (GPT-5.4) as the judge, with input images normalized to a long side of 640 pixels to remove resolution bias.
blocks.zh:
我们按照四个正交轴对组成进行编辑,即组成、图像质量、几何一致性和文本指导准确性,以及一项人类研究。
除非另有说明,所有LLM判断的度量衡都使用与判断器相同的边疆视觉语言模型(GPT-5.4),输入图像正常化为长边640像素来去除分辨率偏差.

blocks.en:
Composition. Comp. WinRate is the pairwise win rate of the edited image against the source, where the judge decides which image is better composed.
We adopt double-order judging that averages both presentation orders to remove position bias, so that a value above 50% indicates improved composition while a near-identity edit lands around 50%. PF-ass scores single-image composition with the PhotoFramer scorer [ 38 ] , with images downsampled to a 0.3M-pixel cap to remove its systematic resolution bias.
blocks.zh:
组成. Comp. WinRate是被编辑的图像相对于源的双向胜率,由法官决定哪个图像更好组成.
我们采用双相顺序来判断,平均来说,两种显示命令都是为了去除位置偏差,这样值超过50%就表明组成有所改进,而近身份编辑则占50%左右。 PF-ass的分数单相成像配有PhotoFramer分数器[38],图像被下取样为0.3M-像素盖来去除其系统性分辨率偏差.

blocks.en: Image Quality. QAlign [ 31 ] scores no-reference aesthetic quality with the aesthetics head of Q-Align, and DeQA [ 37 ] scores general quality in terms of distortion, artifacts, and naturalness.
blocks.zh: 图像质量. QAlign [31] 与"Q-Align"的美学头目分出无参考美学质量,而"德克萨"[37] 在扭曲,文物,自然等方面分出一般质量.

blocks.en:
Geometric Consistency. MET3R [ 1 ] measures multi-view 3D consistency between the edited output and the source, where lower values indicate greater agreement.
Since MET3R inherently rewards under-editing, we complement it with Geo-Suc , a pointwise LLM-judge metric that takes the reference camera motion defined by the source-to-target pair and decides whether the source-to-output change is explainable by the same motion.
It is calibrated against three control arms, i.e., the ground truth as its own candidate (ceiling), the source itself (floor), and a shuffled scene (sanity).
blocks.zh:
相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 MET3R [1] 测量了被编辑的输出和源之间的多视图三维一致性,其中下值表示更大的一致.
由于MET3R在本质上奖励了编辑不足,我们用Geo-Suc来补充它,Geo-Suc是一个有指针的LLM判断度量度,它取自由源对目标对对所定义的参考相机运动,并决定源对输出的变化是否可以由同一种运动来解释.
它根据三种控制武器进行校正,即地面真相是它自己的候选人(上限)、源头本身(地板)和被打乱的场景(平静)。

blocks.en:
Text-Guidance Accuracy. Following the protocol of PhotoFramer [ 38 ] , Text Cons. (src → \rightarrow gen) scores whether the reasoning text accurately describes the method’s own edit, and Text Cons. (src → \rightarrow GT) whether it matches the human reframing, both on a hedging-resistant 1–5 rubric that places unfalsifiable or generic guidance at the bottom.
Pure image generators that emit no reasoning text are excluded from these two metrics.
blocks.zh:
文本指导精准. 在PhotoFramer [38] 的协议之后, Text Cons. (src →\rightarrow gen) 对推理文本是否准确描述方法自己的编辑,以及 Text Cons 进行评分. (src-\rightarrow GT)它是否与人反射相匹配,两者都位于一个可抵御一至五分线,将不可防伪或通用的指向放入底部.
纯图像生成器不发出推理文本被排除于这两个度量.

blocks.en:
Human Study. On a randomly sampled 10% subset of the validation set, annotators are shown the source and an edited candidate and judge whether the candidate, while satisfying geometric consistency, improves composition and image quality over the source.
We report Overall , the fraction of samples for which a method’s edit is judged both geometrically valid and better than the source in composition and quality; higher is better.
blocks.zh:
人类研究. 在随机抽取了10%的验证集子集上,注释者会显示来源,并显示一名被编辑的候选人,判断候选人是否在满足几何一致性的同时,会提高来源的构成和图像质量.
总体来说, 一种方法编辑的样本在几何上是有效的, 在组成和质量上优于来源。

blocks.en: Appendix C Baseline Details
blocks.zh: 附录C 基线 细节

blocks.en:
Under a unified protocol, every model, including ours, receives the general task prompts of the dataset as the textual input together with the poorly-composed image, and produces a composition-improved image with, depending on its capability, an accompanying text guidance.
BAGEL [ 4 ] is an open-source unified multimodal model that couples understanding and generation within a single architecture.
Qwen-Image-Edit [ 30 ] shares the same editing backbone as ours and is paired with Qwen3-VL [ 19 ] as its understanding model.
Step1X-Edit [ 15 ] is a general instruction-based editing framework, which we run in its thinking mode that produces an explicit reasoning trace before editing.
FLUX.2 [ 2 ] is an open-weight flow-matching model for high-quality image generation and editing.
PhotoFramer [ 38 ] is a composition-specific unified understanding-generation model that jointly produces composition guidance and visual exemplars, and we adopt its released preview version.
Nano Banana Pro (Gemini 3 Pro Image) [ 8 ] is a proprietary frontier image generation and editing model.
Among these, all methods except FLUX.2 and Nano Banana Pro emit textual output that serves as the text guidance, whereas the two pure image generators produce only the edited image.
blocks.zh:
根据统一的协议,每个模型,包括我们的模型,都会收到数据集的一般任务提示,作为文字输入和由不良组合而成的图像,并产生一个组合改进的图像,视其能力而定,附带一个文字指导。
BAGEL [4]是一个开源统一多式模式,夫妇在单一架构内理解并生成.
Quen-Image-Edit [30] 与我们共享相同的编辑主干,并被与Qun3-VL [19] 配对作为其理解模式.
Step1X-Edit [15] 是一个基于通用指令的编辑框架,我们按其思维模式运行,在编辑前产生一个明确的推理追踪.
FLUX.2 [2]是一款可进行高品质图像生成和编辑的开口量取流量匹配模型.
PhotoFramer [38] 是一个针对具体成分的统一理解生成模型,它联合产生成分向导和视觉实例,我们采用其已发布的预览版本.
Nano Banana Pro (Gemini 3 Pro Image) [8] 是一款专有的前沿图像生成和编辑模型.
其中,除FLUX.2和Nano Banana外,其他所有方法都包括在内。 Pro发布作为文本指导的文本输出,而两个纯图像生成器只产生被编辑的图像.

Our composition editing model builds upon Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 [ 30 ] , fine-tuned with LoRA of rank 32, while our composition understanding model is obtained by LoRA fine-tuning Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct [ 19 ] with a rank of 32 on the constructed dataset.
Following PhotoFramer [ 38 ] , we design ten different general task prompts T t ​ a ​ s ​ k T_{task} for each task, so that the understanding model is not tied to a single phrasing.
The two stages are implemented with DiffSynth-Studio [ 16 ] and Flow-Factory [ 32 ] , and all training is conducted on 8 GPUs with 80 GB memory each.
In Stage I, we adopt the frozen VGGT-1B [ 26 ] as the geometry foundation model, whose 24-layer aggregator produces 2048-dimensional geometry-aware tokens.
We tap the intermediate image-token features from the 30-th DiT transformer block and align them, through the projection head, to the VGGT patch features at layers { 12 , 18 , 23 } \{12,18,23\} for the local correspondence and global structural supervision, while the camera and register tokens are taken from layers { 18 , 23 } \{18,23\} and concatenated with the target latent z 0 z_{0} before noise is added during training.

In Stage II, we generate K = 16 K=16 candidates per input through rollout sampling and train for 240 epochs with 48 samples per epoch.
The instruction-following and visual-quality rewards are provided by UnifiedReward [ 27 ] and the geometry-consistency reward by Pi3 [ 28 ] with its patch and attention features probed from layer 17.

The policy is optimized with AdamW at 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} , and inference uses 40 diffusion sampling steps.

blocks.en:
To assess generalization beyond the constructed dataset, we evaluate on a held-out benchmark that is strictly disjoint from our training data, i.e., DL3DV [ 13 ] for viewpoint change, under pure image-conditioned re-composition without text guidance.
Table 7 reports the results on the DL3DV-300 subset.
On DL3DV, which requires genuine viewpoint change, GeoComposer attains the best MET3R (0.150) together with the best QAlign, DeQA, and text-guidance faithfulness, whereas several strong editors collapse in geometric consistency, e.g., PhotoFramer reaches a MET3R of 0.453 as it alters the scene without preserving its 3D structure.
GeoComposer is therefore the only method that ranks first on geometric consistency on this benchmark, confirming that the geometric priors learned on the constructed dataset transfer to unseen real data rather than overfitting to our synthesis pipeline.
blocks.zh:
为了评估超出已建数据集的概括性,我们用一个与我们的培训数据严格脱节的搁置基准,即DL3DV[13]用于观点变化,在纯图像条件下重新组合,而不提供文字指导。
表7报告了DL3DV-300子集的结果。

blocks.en: Appendix G Additional Qualitative Results

blocks.en:
Figure 4 presents additional qualitative comparisons that complement the qualitative results in the main paper, covering a broader range of scene types, i.e., animal subjects, natural landscapes, and architectural structures, across the three composition operations of the dataset.
Consistent with the quantitative results, the baselines frequently improve the framing at the expense of the underlying scene, e.g., hallucinating or removing structures, distorting the subject, or drifting to a viewpoint that is no longer explainable by a camera motion over the source scene.
GeoComposer instead re-frames the subject and rebalances the layout while keeping the scene geometry intact, producing visual exemplars that are both better composed and faithful to the source scene.

blocks.en: Appendix H Analysis of the Composition Understanding Model
blocks.zh: 附录H 对组成理解模型的分析

blocks.en:
The two components of GeoComposer are evaluated separately in this section, focusing on the textual guidance T T rather than the generated exemplar.
Table 8 compares our fine-tuned understanding model against the raw Qwen3-VL [ 19 ] used by Qwen-Image-Edit and against PhotoFramer [ 38 ] , reporting both text-consistency metrics together with the average length of the produced guidance.
Our model attains the best consistency in both directions (3.45 and 3.28) while producing by far the shortest guidance, i.e., 58.6 words against 100.9 for PhotoFramer and 210.6 for the raw VLM.
The improvement therefore does not come from describing more, but from describing the right thing: length and faithfulness move in opposite directions here, and the longest outputs are the least consistent with the actual reframing.
blocks.zh:
本节单独评价GeoComposer的两个组件,侧重于文字指导T T而不是生成的示例.
表8将我们的微调理解模型与Quen-Image-Edit所使用的生素Qwen3-VL [19] 和相片Framer [38] 相比较,报告两种文本一致性的度量标准以及所生成的指向的平均长度.
我们的模型在两个方向上都取得了最佳的一致性(3.45和3.28),同时产生了迄今为止最短的取向,即:PhotoFramer用58.6个字对100.9个字,而原始VLM用210.6个字。
因此,改进并非来自更多描述,而是来自对事物的描述:长度和忠诚在这里向相反方向移动,最长的产出与实际的再调整最不相符合.

blocks.en:
Figure 5 makes the nature of this difference visible by showing the word distribution of each model over the validation set.
The raw VLM is dominated by composition theory and subjective impression, e.g., “angle”, “third”, “diagonal”, and “golden” alongside “feel” and “compelling”, so it names the principle a photograph violates and how the result should feel, but rarely states an operation.
PhotoFramer instead concentrates on generic evaluative language, e.g., “pleasing”, “aesthetically”, “enhance”, and “adjustment”, which reads fluently as composition commentary yet leaves the required change under-specified.
Our guidance is dominated by explicit operations, e.g., “zoom”, “crop”, “reframe”, and “adjust”, anchored to spatial referents, e.g., “horizontally”, “horizon”, “center”, “foreground”, and “background”.
Notably, preservation verbs such as “maintaining”, “keeping”, and “ensure” are also prominent, which means the guidance states not only what to change but what must stay fixed.
This is precisely the property that makes T T usable as a conditioning signal for geometry-preserving editing, and it explains why a much shorter instruction transfers better to the editing model.
blocks.zh:
图5通过显示每个模型相对于验证集的字数分布,使这种差异的性质变得明显.
原始的VLM以组成理论和主观印象为主,例如,“相干”、“相干”、“相干”和“相干”与“相干”和“相干”,因此它把照片所违反的原则以及结果的感受命名,但很少说明一项行动。
PhotoFramer则专注于一般评价语言,如“美化”、“美化”、“增强”和“调整”,其措词流利地为“组成评注”,但却没有具体指明所要求的变化。
我们的指导以明确的操作为主,例如“Zoom”、“crom”、“reframe”和“adjust”,以空间参照法为基础,例如“范围”、“范围”、“中心”、“前地”和“背景”。
值得注意的是,诸如“维持”、“保持”和“确保”等保留动词也十分突出,这意味着指南不仅规定要改变什么,而且规定必须固定什么。
这恰恰是使T T 可用于几何保存编辑的调制信号的属性,它解释了为什么一个更短的指令会更好地传输到编辑模型.

Source-Target Reward Balance (Stage II). Table 12 varies the weights w s : w t w_{s}{:}w_{t} that balance source preservation against target alignment in the geometry reward.
Removing source preservation entirely ( 0 : 1 0{:}1 ) degrades MET3R to 0.209, confirming that the source term is what anchors the output to the input scene.
Conversely, raising the source weight to 5 : 5 5{:}5 or 7 : 3 7{:}3 does reach a lower MET3R (0.176 and 0.174), but at a sharp cost in composition and quality, e.g., PF-ass drops from 3.133 to 2.999 and 2.988.
These configurations improve MET3R by suppressing the edit rather than by better preserving geometry, which is precisely the under-editing bias of the metric noted above, and therefore do not represent a genuinely better trade-off.
We adopt 3 : 7 3{:}7 , which attains the best QAlign, DeQA, and PF-ass while keeping MET3R at 0.184.

相反,提高 源重为:5 5{:}5或7 :3 7{:}3确实达到较低的MET3R(0.176和0.174),但是在组成和质量方面成本高昂,例如PF-ass从3.133降至2.9999和2.988.
这些配置通过压制编辑而不是更好地保存几何来改进MET3R,这恰恰是上述度量衡的编辑不足偏差,因此并不代表真正更好的取舍.
我们采用3:7 3{:}7, 达到最佳QAlign, DeQA和PF-ass,同时将MET3R保持在0.184。

blocks.en:
In summary, both Stage I design choices converge on the same conclusion, i.e., our configuration attains the best MET3R while remaining competitive on quality and composition, which is what this stage is meant to deliver, as its sole purpose is to instill geometric consistency into the representations.
In Stage II, where the hybrid reward must balance geometry against instruction following and visual quality, our configuration instead attains the best overall trade-off across the four metrics, i.e., the best MET3R for the attention-feature balance, and the best QAlign, DeQA, and PF-ass for the source-target balance, in which the two source-heavy settings reach a lower MET3R only by suppressing the compositional change that the task requires.
This reflects the central design principle of GeoComposer, i.e., to prioritize geometric consistency without sacrificing the edit itself.
blocks.zh:
简言之,第一阶段的两个设计选择都是一致的结论,即:我们的配置在质量和组成方面保持竞争力,同时达到最佳的MET3R,这是这一阶段要达到的目的,因为其唯一目的是将几何一致性注入表述。
在第二阶段,混合奖励必须平衡几何学和随从和视觉质量的教学,相反,我们的配置在四个度量中实现了最佳的总体取舍,即注意-地平面的最佳MET3R,以及源-目标平衡的最佳QAlign、DeQA和PF-ass,其中两个源重设置只能通过压制任务所需的组成变化达到较低的MET3R。
这反映了GeoComposer的中央设计原则,即优先排列几何一致性而不会牺牲编辑本身.
